items.text: Labels now fade in ~4x faster (solid in ~6 frames instead of ~27) while keeping their slow slide and settle, so there is no long see-through phase. Applies to every label.

Referral invite sheet no longer fades in over the nav bar: it slides up from the bottom fully solid (with the WhatsApp / Instagram row), only the dark backdrop fades. It also slides back down solid at the end.
Referral invite sheet slides up slower: 20 frames (was 12), same soft landing. (Read this as the sheet; the label slide-in is unchanged; say if you meant the label.)
